ArrayBuffer ma.arrayBufferToBase64(ArrayBuffer arrayBuffer)

Convert an ArrayBuffer object to a Base64 character string (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Parameter

ArrayBuffer arrayBuffer

ArrayBuffer object to convert to a Base64 string

Return Value

string

Base64 character string

Sample Code

const arrayBuffer = new Uint8Array([11, 22, 33]);
const base64 = ma.arrayBufferToBase64(arrayBuffer);
